title: Budget-conscious prefetch operator and quant-tiered fallback
author: Priya Patel
description: Context: We see occasional tenant cost blowups when aggressive prefetch/prefill heuristics combine with sudden bursty traffic and conservative KV-cache reuse. This PR implements a budget-conscious prefetch operator plus a small policy engine for quant-tiered fallbacks so that inference remains available while respecting tenant budget and unit-econ constraints. Motivation: reduce tail cost spikes, make safe automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants when budget signals or latency tolerance allow, and instrument unit-econ metrics so the ops team and the cost advisor can validate behavior in production. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a new prefill operator (pkg/prefill/budget_operator.go) that tracks an adaptive budget window per-tenant and throttles speculative prefetching during burst windows. The operator uses a short predictive window (exponential decay counter) to avoid cold-prefetch storms. 2) Adds a quant-tier policy adaptor (runtime/quant/policy.go) that can fall back from fp16->int8->sparse-4bit variants based on combined signals: tenant budget headroom, latency SLO headroom, and recent model-quality checks. 3) Hooks unit-econ telemetry into the control loop (telemetry/unit_econ/*) emitting tokens_per_dollar, prefetch_efficiency, fallback_count and cost_delta_by_tier metrics. 4) Provides a CLI dry-run and simulator (tools/prefill-sim) to validate policies against replayed traffic traces. 5) Adds canary rollouts with gradual risk gating and a per-tenant override API (api/v1/prefill-override). Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag `budget_prefill_v1` and enabled by default for staging. Contains a simulator mode for offline testing. Backwards compatibility: All operator changes are additive; defaults are conservative and fallbacks require both budget and SLO signals. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-4983) - [x] Unit tests for operator and policy - [x] Integration tests in perf canary harness - [x] Telemetry dashboards smoke tests - [x] CLI dry-run and simulator smoke tests - [x] Docs: README + rollout playbook Not included: quality-regression detector (separate follow-up ENG-5021) Single-string description: this entire block is the continuous description; please see commits for granular diffs and review comments for followups.
